page: Vultr vx1-g-96c-384g-5760s is a dedicated cloud server instance belonging to the VX1 Cloud Compute family. It is equipped with 96 dedicated AMD vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are fully reserved for the instance, preventing performance degradation from shared-tenant resource contention.

The instance features 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. Local storage is comprised of a 5760 GB NVMe SSD, offering high-capacity, low-latency storage directly attached to the instance. This configuration does not include any graphics processing units.

With its high core count, substantial memory capacity, and large NVMe storage volume, this server is configured for resource-intensive workloads. It is suitable for large-scale databases, enterprise applications, data processing pipelines, and high-concurrency web serving. The instance also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.
description: Vultr vx1-g-96c-384g-5760s is a dedicated x86_64 cloud server from the VX1 Cloud Compute family, featuring 96 dedicated AMD vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM. This configuration maintains a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. It is equipped with 5760 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, offering high-capacity and low-latency data access, but does not include GPU acceleration. The instance comes with one complimentary public IPv4 address. Given its substantial compute, memory, and storage resources, this server is designed for demanding workloads such as large-scale databases, enterprise applications, data processing, and high-concurrency web serving. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, making it a reliable option for production environments requiring high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency.
